notes: Initial setup browser stalled after showing credentials. Another cloud run resumed the same room, without creating a replacement.
The automatic browser reports mislabeled V2 as round 1; PostgreSQL and application source confirm round 2.
P01 ACEITO was explicitly submitted in the observer run. Polling does not create votes.
Nominal polling interval is 4 seconds while the page is active; exact delivery latency was not measured.
No new Gemini calls were needed for this focused regression; earlier real Gemini validation is separate.
No credentials are included in this evidence file.
